answer: Hardware-rooted attestation curbs Sybil attacks by having each agent bind its key inside a trusted enclave to a unique hardware endorsement certificate before taking jobs like voyage routing or raven monitoring. Because the registry allows one key per chip and hardware counters verify each signed state delta to stop snapshot cloning, attackers incur the capital cost of distinct silicon per identity. Still, side-channel leaks or compromised vendor keys can let one host emulate many nodes.
